title: Privacy Policy | Lotus Capital
headline: Privacy Policy
summary: Understand how Lotus Capital collects, uses, and safeguards information submitted through our services and website.
_comment: TODO: Client / legal counsel to confirm effective date upon final compliance review.

sections.title: 1. Legal Entity & Privacy Contact
sections.copy: Lotus Capital operates as a financial services firm located at Shri Chudasama Bhuvan, M.G. Road, Near Police Chowki No. 1, Godhra 389001, Panchmahals, Gujarat. For privacy-related inquiries, clarifications, or requests regarding personal data, you can reach us directly at lotuscapitalinfo@gmail.com or call +91 93288 52555.

sections.title: 2. Data We Collect
sections.copy: We collect information submitted voluntarily through our service enquiry forms, including your full name, 10-digit Indian mobile number, optional email address, selected service of interest, enquiry message text, preferred contact method (phone, WhatsApp, or email), source URL, and campaign attribution parameters (UTM tags). We do not collect cookies or tracker profiles for profiling.

sections.title: 3. Strict Data Minimisation
sections.copy: This website never requests or collects sensitive credentials such as passwords, OTPs, login credentials, PAN card numbers, Aadhaar numbers, or bank account credentials. Please do not submit financial access credentials through any digital enquiry form or email.

sections.title: 4. Purpose of Data Processing
sections.copy: Information collected is processed solely to respond to your service enquiry, clarify your insurance or investment requirements, facilitate introductory discussions with authorised advisors, and maintain compliance records as required by Indian financial regulatory frameworks.

sections.title: 5. Sharing with Regulated Product Providers
sections.copy: Your personal details are shared with authorised partner insurers, broking partner Religare Broking Limited, or Asset Management Companies (AMCs) only after your explicit instruction and consent to proceed with a formal application, policy issuance, or Demat account opening.

sections.title: 6. Security & Data Retention
sections.copy: We implement transport layer security (HTTPS encryption), role-based access controls for authorized personnel, and secure audit logging. Personal data is retained strictly for periods necessary to fulfill service requests or comply with applicable Indian statutory record-keeping obligations.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights & Contact Channel
sections.copy: You have the right to request access to the personal information you have submitted, request corrections to inaccurate records, or ask to withdraw consent for further advisory communication. To exercise these rights, please write to lotuscapitalinfo@gmail.com with your contact details.
